description: This file defines the LoggerBasicConfigurator class, which provides methods to configure logging in the log4php framework, specifically by adding a console appender with a TTCC layout and resetting the configuration.

classes.name: LoggerBasicConfigurator
classes.description: A class providing static methods for quick configuration and resetting logging setup in log4php.

methods.name: LoggerBasicConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor for LoggerBasicConfigurator, performs no special initialization.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the root logger by adding a console appender with a TTCC layout.

methods.name: resetConfiguration
methods.description: Resets the logging configuration to default via LoggerManager.
